structData.program_name: Littleton's Illustrated Guide to Mint Marks on Regular-Issue U.S. Coins
structData.mint_info: Mint marks on older coins are typically on the reverse, often below a wreath or eagle. Modern coins usually feature the mint mark on the obverse, near the date or portrait. Some recent dollar series, like the Presidential and Native American dollars, have the mint mark on the edge of the coin. The Philadelphia 'P' mint mark was generally not used until 1980, with notable exceptions like the 1942-45 'Wartime' nickel.
